verdict.rationale: PostHog Workflows lets users choose when a workflow triggers on the product events and person properties they already send, then run steps such as delays, audience splits, message sends and PostHog actions. Realtime CDP destinations, including a generic webhook, can be filtered by event type, property or SQL to fire actions on arriving events, and their Hog functions can be written by PostHog AI. The AI-native angle is covered by a Workflows MCP tool family (30 tools) that agents can use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that event-triggered workflows and destinations work as documented.
